entities.summary: Zhu Fangyu is a former professional Chinese professional basketball player, who spent his entire pro club career with the Guangdong Southern Tigers of the Chinese Basketball Association (CBA). Standing at a height of 2.01 meters (6'7") tall, and weighing 104 kilograms, he played at the small forward position. He was nicknamed "The Rain of Three-Pointers", due to his ability to sink three-pointers at crucial moments during games.
